name: PWA CRISP HEADER RENDERING
changes: Fixes the soft/blurred-looking mobile PWA header without changing status-bar or safe-area behavior
Removes fractional micro-typography from VA / VA HOME / OPERATIONS and restores native font smoothing in the header only
Uses heavier integer-sized brand typography, an even 8px sync dot and a 24px search icon with integer geometry
Disables the inherited active scale transform on the mobile search button so iOS does not rasterize the control during taps
notes: Built directly on the verified v16.4.13 rollback/stable tree.
The diagnosis is visual-rendering softness, not a remaining CSS blur layer: the topbar already has filter:none/backdrop-filter:none and its border stays crisp.
No status-bar mode, safe-area geometry, navigation, Supabase, Edge Function, Monobank, Nova Poshta or VAcleaner runtime change.
